name: The Poro Parade
text: Keywords: Landmark. I-II: Manifest a follower that has a different subtype than allies in play. III: Give an ally +1|+1 this round for each ally with a subtype.

name: Brynhir Thundersong
text: Play: Obliterate a unit in hand to summon a Stormcarved Spire that has Countdown equal to its cost and summons an exact copy of the unit. (minimum 1)

name: Ultrasoft Poro
text: Play: Heal your Nexus 1 for each ally with a subtype.

name: Uncle Milty
text: Keywords: Impact. Grant me 2 Spirit once you've completed a Story.

name: Mercenary Manners
text: Steal an enemy follower with 3 or less Health this round. (Can't play if you have 6 allies or landmarks already.)

name: Vladimir (level 2)
text: Keywords: Fearsome, Regeneration. Play: Deal 1 to any number of allies to deal that much to an enemy. Attack: For each attacking ally on my right, deal 1 to it and drain 1 from the enemy Nexus.

name: Teemo (level 2)
text: Keywords: Elusive. Nexus Strike: Double the Poison Puffcaps in the enemy deck (plants 5 minimum).

name: Fizz (level 2)
text: Keywords: Imbue. When you play a spell, stop all enemy spells and Skills targeting me and give me Elusive this round. Nexus Strike: Create a Chum the Waters in hand.

name: Maokai (level 2)
text: Keywords: Regeneration. When I level up, Obliterate the enemy deck, leaving 4 non-champions. Round Start: Summon a Sapling.

name: Zilean (level 2)
text: Round Start: Create a Fleeting copy of each non-Fleeting card I saw you play last round. Play: Create 4 Time Bombs in your deck, then Predict.

name: Azir (level 2)
text: When I level up, replace your deck with the Emperor's Deck, then draw 1. When allies attack, summon an attacking Sandstone Charger.

name: LeBlanc (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. Each time you deal 15+ damage, create a Mirror Image in hand. If you already have one, reduce its cost by 1 instead.

name: Viego (level 2)
text: Keywords: Fearsome. Each round, the first time another unit dies, summon an Encroaching Mist. Round Start: Steal the strongest enemy this round. If it's a champion, kill it instead.

name: Senna (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, Missing Translation. When I'm summoned or Attack: Create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one. Your damage and kill spells accelerate to Fast and cost 1 less.

name: Pantheon (level 2)
text: Keywords: Overwhelm, Barrier. Once a Pantheon has leveled up, grant me a random keyword for each round you've targeted allies this game.

name: Gwen (level 2)
text: Keywords: Hallowed, Quick Attack. Attack: When another ally gains Power from Hallowed, so do I. Drain 1 from the enemy Nexus one time for every 2 Power I have.

name: Crimson Pact
text: Keywords: Skill. For each attacking ally on Vladimir's right, deal 1 to it and drain 1 from the enemy Nexus.

name: Hatched Egg
text: Keywords: Burst. Draw 2 different Dragons.

name: Swapbot's Swap
text: Keywords: Skill. Swap my Power and Health with that of another unit.

name: Blade
text: Obliterate me when I leave combat.

name: Lucky Find (created)
text: Keywords: Fleeting, Focus. Pick a buff from among 3 to grant an ally.

name: Restored Sun Disc
text: Keywords: Landmark. Immediately draw 1 of each of your Ascended allies. For the rest of the game, your level 2 Ascended allies are level 3.

name: Salty Spinner
text: Keywords: Impact. When I'm summoned or Round Start: Grant me +0|+2 for each card you discarded last round, then shuffle my stats.

name: Entrapment (created)
text: Keywords: Burst. Pick 1 of 3 spells from the enemy deck and plant 3 Poison Puffcaps on all copies of it.

name: Entrapment (created)
text: Keywords: Burst. Pick 1 of 3 units from the enemy deck and plant 3 Poison Puffcaps on all copies of it.

name: Children of the Forest (created)
text: Keywords: Fast. Summon Ephemeral copies of the 3 strongest followers you've Recalled this game.

name: Snip Snip Snip!
text: Keywords: Skill. Drain 1 from the enemy Nexus one time for every 2 power Gwen has. (max 50 times, min 2 times)

name: Seraphine's High Note
text: Keywords: Fast. Deal 2 to a unit. If you've played 6+ other new spells this game, deal 1 to another unit. Create a Seraphine in your deck.

name: Fish Fight (created)
text: Keywords: Slow. An Equipped ally strikes an enemy, then is unequipped.

name: Taarosh
text: Keywords: Fearsome. Each round, the first time I attack, fill your attackers with revived Ephemeral copies of the strongest followers you've slain this game.

name: Quietus (created)
text: Keywords: Slow. Kill a unit with total Power and Health of 4 or less.

name: Secure the Goods
text: Keywords: Skill. Capture my enemy.

name: Ingvar the Younger (created)
text: Play: Grant an ally and all other allies that share a subtype with it +1|+1.

name: Ingvar the Younger (created)
text: Play: Manifest a follower that shares a subtype with an ally.

name: Soul Shackles
text: Keywords: Skill. Deal 3 to Cursed enemies and 2 to the enemy Nexus.

name: Poet's Recital
text: Keywords: Skill, Slow. Kill a unit with total Power and Health 5 or less.

name: The Beautiful Disaster (created)
text: Keywords: Landmark, Slow. I: Kill a unit with total Power and Health 5 or less. II: Drain the enemy Nexus 2. III: Summon an exact copy of an ally. It's Ephemeral and 1|1.

name: Umbral Smoke
text: Keywords: Skill, Slow. Obliterate all cards Captured by allies.

name: Poro Captain
text: Keywords: Skill, Focus. Give an ally +1|+1 this round for each ally with a subtype.

name: Poro Entourage
text: Keywords: Skill, Focus. Manifest a follower that has a different subtype than allies in play.
